title: Search-backed List silently drops pages after authorization filtering
answers: Why does search-backed List stop paginating early / skip authorized items?
List response has no NextPageToken even though more matching resources exist
Clients missing resources after permission/authorization filtering on a list request
How to make search List continuation aware of authorization filtering
body:
Symptom: A client paging through a search-backed List (resourcepb.ListRequest with selectors) silently stops receiving resources — no NextPageToken is returned even though more authorized rows exist further in the search index.
Root cause: pkg/storage/unified/resource/list_with_selectors.go:listWithSelectors only relied on the raw search page size to decide whether to continue; it did not account for authorization filtering shrinking a full page, or post-rank authorization returning a short page when the search response's total hit count is inexact.
Fix pattern: after building the response, call a helper (searchListNeedsContinue(limit, rowCount, totalHitsExact)) that decides if a continuation token is still needed — true when the page is full (rowCount >= limit) or the total is inexact — then build the token from the last row's sortFields via NewSearchContinueToken, reusing the original listRv (not the fresh search response RV).
Constraints: applies specifically to search-backed List (list_with_selectors.go), not plain unified-storage List. If the last row has no sortFields (e.g. it was itself filtered/replaced), no token can be built — log a warning and return without a token instead of erroring.
applies: pkg/storage/unified/resource list_with_selectors.go — search-backed List pagination with post-fetch authorization filtering
